## Traces to

Which ASR(s) does this decision answer? (Required — an ADR with no ASR trace doesn't belong in this library.)

## Context

What situation makes this decision necessary?

## Decision

State the decision plainly. Use a table if it's tiered or multi-option.

## Consequences

What follows from this decision — intended and unintended, positive and negative?
